target.description: Id of exactly one {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

processId.description: The decimal Queue Manager id: processId from find_processes (queueLog workflowId); a UUID globalProcessId is not accepted

fileName.description: The queue file name as query_logs with logType queueLog lists it in fields.fileName; needed when the process has several ERROR entries

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of the data stream text returned (masked text; the full size is always reported)
